name: handoff
description: Session handoff toolkit. Ships /handoff (capture the current session into a structured 10-section markdown file in <repo>/.handoff/ — tracking done/in-progress/blockers/next-step, chaining to the previous handoff, and pinning the related plan + commit SHAs) and /handoff-resume (load the latest handoff in a new session, follow its plan pointer, summarise it, and proceed after user confirmation).
